**Skill ID:** 777

## Description

Boosts Armor of nearby characters by 2 for 60 seconds and angers enemies.

Name and tooltip: official English client text (`locale.xml`, `en_US`).

**Historical community name:** Armor Buff 1. [Faction Gear, revision 163921](https://legouniverse.fandom.com/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&revids=163921&rvprop=ids%7Ccontent&rvslots=main&formatversion=2&format=json) associates this name with Rank 1 Knight Helm; the local data associates [Knight Helm 1 (LOT 7355)](../items/7355.md) with skill 777. This indirect equipment match differs from the official client name, which takes precedence.
